verdict.rationale: Fly.io's docs show a single-command workflow (`fly launch` after installing flyctl) that scaffolds and deploys a new app, and the official CLI is documented at fly.io/docs/flyctl/. However, multiple community reports describe the deploy step itself as unreliable — e.g. 'pushing simple containers up would fail 70-80% of the time with no useful error messages,' and other users report deploys leaving apps stuck/unreachable — directly contradicting the claim of a smooth one-command deploy experience. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that `fly launch` reliably completes scaffold+deploy without the flakiness reported by multiple users.
